name: day_octopus
description: Day octopus (Octopus cyanea) resting on sand, facing right: mottled red-brown #b5523a skin with dark reticulation and cream patches, bag-shaped mantle raised behind (top ~y -405), two raised eye bumps with horizontal bar pupils under heavy lids (not cute), pale dark-ringed false eyespot on the web under the eye, eight thick arms spread low and wide with curled tips showing pale suckers. Anchor bottom-centre (arms on the sand at y 0); ~x -350..350, y -410..0.
